name: Temple of Arkkoran
summary: On Azshara’s northeastern cliffs, the Temple of Arkkoran looks out over the Shattered Strand. Elune’s old sanctuary now belongs to Arkkoroc and his aquatic thralls.

sections.title: A Consecrated Ruin Claimed by the Sea
sections.body: Elune, the moon goddess, was once honored at the Temple of Arkkoran. The Sundering shattered the ancient night elf empire and left the temple in ruin. Now tidal monstrosities crowd its marble steps and broken colonnades. Arkkoroc rules from the highest level, with loyal makrura and vicious murlocs at his side. Together, they defend the nearby coast from land-dwelling intruders.

faq.q: What was the Temple of Arkkoran originally built for?
faq.answer: Night elves built the Temple of Arkkoran as a sanctuary to Elune. The Great Sundering ruined it and the coastal civilization around it.
Arkkoroc is a powerful sea giant who has made the former night elf temple his home. From its highest platform, he commands the shore and its coastal beasts.

faq.q: What creatures guard the temple grounds?
aliases: what lives at temple of arkkoran
faq.answer: Aggressive makrura and murlocs patrol the temple and its terraces, including Arkkoran clackers, pincers, and muckdwellers. Hydras and other sea giants live on the Shattered Strand beaches.

angles.text: As a night elf, you see Elune’s sacred house overrun by makrura and sea giants. Its ruin recalls the splendor lost ten thousand years ago.
As a priest, you can still see ancient symbols of Elune among the weathered stones. No divine communion remains in these sea-battered ruins.
